A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Infoprop research, with the same title and authors. Their complete main text and Appendices A–E, including equations, figures and tables, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original random-walk simulations and Infoprop-Dyna experiments on MuJoCo, including rollout-quality evaluations and learning-stability ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains these original simulations, MuJoCo evaluations and appendix ablations. The attribution of some baseline results to prior work does not negate the original Infoprop results.

M1.justification: Infoprop's uncertainty decomposition, propagation procedure, information-loss stopping criteria and Dyna integration remain unchanged in Sections 4–5 and Algorithms 1–3. The revised explanation of model error introduces no procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same one-dimensional random-walk example and MuJoCo Halfcheetah, Walker, Hopper, Ant and Humanoid tasks. No training or evaluation domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Trajectory Sampling, MBPO, MACURA and SAC retain the same participation in the corresponding rollout and performance comparisons. The ground-truth and asymptotic SAC references are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain the 120,000-interaction Hopper setup, the same rollout horizons and evaluation procedures, and the settings in Tables 1–4. The reworded histogram description in Section 6.3 does not change the evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Appendix E retains the same 100-step rollout-consistency comparison, Humanoid stability diagnostics, and Hopper threshold and layer-normalization ablations. No supplementary analysis is added, removed or revised.

E5.justification: Appendix E.1 states five random seeds per experiment in both versions. The plotted uncertainty bands and statistical reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: The result plots in Figures 1 and 4–12 are unchanged, including returns, rollout lengths, state distributions, critic losses and ablation outcomes. No numerical result or qualitative finding is added, removed or corrected.

T1.justification: The definitions, assumptions, theorem and Appendix D derivations are unchanged. Equation (10) receives delimiter-formatting changes, and Lemma 3 changes its reference from (16) to (57); neither changes mathematical content or reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: reducing epistemic distortion, tracking accumulated model error, enabling longer consistent rollouts and achieving state-of-the-art Dyna-style performance on several MuJoCo tasks.

C2.justification: Both retain the explanations involving nonstationary replay buffers, primacy bias, critic overfitting and plasticity loss, together with the Humanoid limitations and layer-normalization discussion. The edits in Sections 6.3–6.4 preserve their substantive meaning.

D1.justification: The code-access links, pseudocode, logging information and hyperparameters in Appendices B, C and E are unchanged. Updated contact and funding text adds no technical implementation or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 7 and the reference list retain the same cited works and research positioning. No novelty claim or substantive relationship to prior research is revised.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited wording edits in Sections 4.2, 4.4 and 6.3–6.4, including correcting 'mudel' to 'model'. It updates publication, contact and funding details and Lemma 3's equation reference. The section structure remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves from the bottom to the top of page 2 without changing its plot or caption. Minor text reflow and equation-formatting changes occur elsewhere; the remaining figures and tables retain their displays and organization.

improvement.justification: The wording fixes and Figure 1 relocation provide slight editorial polish while leaving the scientific arguments, experimental evidence, limitations and reproducibility information unchanged. Lemma 3's revised reference points to its own Equation (57), replacing the more informative link to Equation (16). These small edits do not produce a meaningful net change in overall quality.
